message.content:
A medium-sized apple (about 182 g) typically contains around **95 calories**.  
- Small apples (~149 g) have roughly **70–80 calories**.  
- Large apples (~223 g) can reach **110–120 calories**.

These values can vary slightly depending on the variety and ripeness, but most apples fall within the 70–120‑calorie range.
